row.notes: Builds the live car (CarLive) for a vehicle entity's physics component phys (vtable 0x145bf73a0 slot 7; phys is CarPhysicsRecord). Finds wheel nodes, allocates CarLive (0x9f60, allocator [phys+0x48]) and CarDynamics (0xa80, vt 0x145bff4d0, at car+0x900, dyn+0x18 = car), registers car in g_Sess_VehicleTable[g_Sess_VehicleCount++] with car+0xe8 = id (0x14462963e), stores car at phys+0x58, sets car+0x4a8 = [[phys+0x9e8]+0x28] vehicle asset and car+0x9f40 = handling version, runs Car_Assets_CreateSystemForPerformanceMode(asset, car+0x380), calls each system's vt+0x30(0), collects 7 phase callback lists (vt+0x28) into car+0x4f8..+0x528, calls vt+0x18(-1), then Car_Build_VtfComponents. Name is historical; it is the car create. Returns nothing (proto corrected per V1275). Also clamps g_Car_TyreContactSubStepCyclePlayer and g_Car_TyreContactSubStepCycleAi to at least 1 (v < 2 ? 1 : v, stores 0x1446295e1 / 0x1446295f3) Runtime 2026-10-28 (T119/T120): runs once per car at session load (21 cars incl. the safety car); its CreateSystemForPerformanceMode call returns to 0x1446296ea; nothing rebuilds a car during the race.
